records.name: Weavers Way Co-op
records.summary: A member-owned food co-op in Northwest Philadelphia with a Farm Market that the public can shop. Members help run the store by volunteering their time.
records.what_you_do: Shop the Farm Market, join as a member, or sign up for a working membership to help out in the store.

schedule.text: Farm Market open Tuesday and Friday 11 am to 7 pm, and Saturday 10 am to 4 pm

cost.text: Membership cost is not listed on the site

first_step.how: Visit the Farm Market, or use the Join Now button on the site to become a member
first_step.basis: The Farm Market is open to the public and the site has a clear way to join

records.notes: Kind is the closest fit from the list; it is a member-owned grocery co-op. The site reports over 15,000 volunteer hours in 2025 and lists a Working Membership page, but its terms were not visible. The site does not name Saul High School, which an older listing did, so that is not recorded. Status comes from a Weekly Specials PDF covering October 7 to 13, 2026.

records.name: Muhibbah Dinners
records.summary: A yearly community dinner started by chef Ange Branca, where several chefs cook one shared menu. The money raised goes to legal help for immigrant families.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a multi-course dinner. The menu is kept secret until the night, and proceeds support immigrant legal aid.

schedule.text: One dinner a year; the most recent one found was on March 25, 2025

cost.text: Ticket price not shown in the article; check the site

first_step.how: Check the next dinner page on the site for tickets and the date
first_step.basis: Open to the public by ticket, with no membership needed

records.notes: No 2026 dinner was found. The official site was not fetched; its address comes from the 6abc article, which says tickets and details are at muhibbahdinners.org/next-dinner. The venue changes each year, so no location is recorded.

records.name: Habibi Supper Club
records.notes: A chef-run paid pop-up dinner (about $65 to $95 a person, one or two dinners a month). It is a food business, not a community program. Article dated October 14, 2024; the site showed no dated events.

leads_only.name: Vetri Community Partnership Teaching Kitchen (free community cooking classes, all ages)
leads_only.note: Strong candidate. Address 915 Spring Garden St. per this page. The class schedule (every other Tuesday, evening and senior daytime classes) and volunteer shifts were seen only in search snippets from vetricommunity.org, which returned 403, so not verified. Needs a re-check from another source.

leads_only.name: Lutheran Settlement House monthly community meal (Fishtown)
leads_only.note: Fetched. The only dated listing is April 20, 2023, and the page says the meal recurs every third Thursday. No newer date found, so not published. Confirm the current schedule with the house before writing a record. Office phone is on the page.

leads_only.name: Roots and Shoots free community meal (Fishtown)
leads_only.note: Fetched. Says meals are planned at least once a month, free, for people facing hunger. Only dated item is a 2019 footer. No current evidence, so not published.

leads_only.name: Homebrewers of Philadelphia and Suburbs (H.O.P.S.)
leads_only.note: Fetched. Regional homebrew club, meets third Thursday at Home Sweet Homebrew per the page. Page dated 2014; current meetings not confirmed. Home area is the suburbs (in_city false if published). Contact is an email link on the page.

leads_only.name: Philadelphia Homebrew Club and Philly Homebrew Outlet club nights
leads_only.note: Not fetched. Article from 2014 says club night is the third Friday at the shop; a 2018 wine class notice was also mentioned in search. Needs current evidence from the shop's own site.

leads_only.name: Philly Dinner Club (women-only monthly dinners and meetups)
leads_only.note: Guide dated August 2025 says the club posts a monthly calendar. No website or calendar was found, so no public way in was confirmed. Women-only; check whether it has a public sign-up page.

leads_only.name: Mangia Montco dining out Meetup
leads_only.note: Meetup lead only, not read. Covers Montgomery and Bucks counties and Philadelphia; dining and wine tastings.

leads_only.name: Philly Suburbs Dining Out Meetup
leads_only.note: Meetup lead only. A February 2014 article says it is free to join and attendees pay a $2 fee to the organizer. Newer evidence needed.

leads_only.name: Free Library Culinary Literacy Center (Edible Alphabet, public cooking classes)
leads_only.note: Blocked (403). Program described in search results only. Try the Free Library event calendar from another page if it is reachable.

leads_only.name: Taste of African Heritage (Oldways) Philadelphia partner classes
leads_only.note: Fetched. Post dated June 18, 2015. Partner sites included the Free Library Culinary Literacy Center, Olney Branch, Feast of Justice, Community Center at Visitation and Agatston Urban Nutrition Initiative. Current Philadelphia classes not confirmed; the class directory page had no Philadelphia listings.

leads_only.name: Faemily Table dinner series
leads_only.note: Article from search results only. No official website was seen. Dinners are open to anyone interested in food and conversation. Find the group's own page before any record.

leads_only.name: South Philly Food Co-op
leads_only.note: Fetched. Article dated December 18, 2020 says it was about to open, about 1,400 co-owners, mostly volunteer run. Opening and current status not confirmed.

leads_only.name: Mariposa Food Co-op (Baltimore Avenue, West Philadelphia)
leads_only.note: Fetched. Article dated June 28, 2011. Older 2012 articles give conflicting membership costs ($200 equity versus $25 a year) and addresses. Current site needed; no domain was checked.

leads_only.name: Manayunk-Roxborough Food Co-op (farmers market origin)
leads_only.note: Search result only. Co-op began around 2011 with a farmers market and an interim board. Current status unknown.

leads_only.name: People's Kitchen (South Philadelphia free meals and volunteers)
leads_only.note: Search result only. Article from 2023 says it was recruiting volunteers to cook and serve. No website found. Confirm recruiting status before any record.

leads_only.name: Santé wine classes and pop-up dinners
leads_only.note: Named in a 2024 roundup. Looks like a small business, not checked. Likely not_a_group.

leads_only.name: Ocho Supper Club and Boy Supper Club (home dinners)
leads_only.note: Named in a 2024 roundup. Chef-run paid dinners, likely businesses. Not checked.

notes: Thin result. Only 3 checked records (2 publish, 1 not_a_group) because most cooking and food groups found were dated before 2024, were businesses, or were blocked. Searches used: 9 of 10. Several list items (the Vetri Teaching Kitchen, the Free Library center, the People's Kitchen) are the best next leads; they need a different route to their current pages. Out of area: BUZZ (West Chester) and Keystone Hops (Montgomeryville) were named in a 2014 search result and not recorded. One-off events (First Presbyterian casserole assembly, Community College of Philadelphia meal serving) were skipped as not groups. The Common Market food hub is a business and was not recorded.
